test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘SUBTLE’ is written as ‘40CUMF’, ‘HANGER’ is written as ‘9OHFS’, how will ‘CLOTH’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SUBTLE’ is written as ‘40CUMF',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2266f8fd215c5f8185102b29609523e02084192057ac2f5b582fba7de4d5dd79.png] 

'HANGER’ is written as ‘9OHFS',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a14971fba238fa3432cde6501f3b26f7ed60fb05d67f4a90b0a2cbd4c813c11d.png] 

Similarly, for '**CLOTH**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d070ba25661c2a3b4f9d7408834a66a6420f27ad12809faf3b3f45c2b9da13.png] 

So, 'CLOTH' is written as '**15PUI**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
